title: Octokit logs an upstream error message unredacted during the App JWT clock-skew retry
resolution: Both Octokit clients get a logger that discards everything; a test captures console and stdio during the clock skew retry.

title: A refresh overtaken by a revocation loses its new token when its cleanup revocation fails
resolution: A revocation waits for pending refreshes, whose tokens join the versions, so it ends them or fails unavailable for a retry.

title: A rejected or malformed token grant is forgotten when its cleanup revocation fails or is skipped
resolution: A token is read apart from its grant; a refused or malformed answer's token is revoked, or kept and revoked before the next call.

title: Ensuring merge protection drops existing required reviews, push restrictions, and strict checks
resolution: Per coordinator decision D2 the protection is read first; any setting the PUT would drop or weaken fails precondition-failed unwritten.

title: Grant validation accepts GitHub permissions beyond the requested ones
resolution: The raw App permission map must equal the request apart from metadata read; extra statuses or administration write is refused.

title: A refresh can return the same expiry as the previous version, not a later one
resolution: A refresh whose expiry is not later than the newest version's is revoked and fails unavailable; tested in one emulated second.

title: An unconfirmed token revocation maps to other codes than unavailable
resolution: Every revocation answer other than success or 401 maps to unavailable and keeps the token; table test of 403, 404, 422, 500.

title: Remote URL validation misses the length, IPv6 literal, and port rules of the contract
resolution: Remote URLs are checked against the execution wire RemoteUrl pattern and its 2048 character bound, with IPv6 and port 0 tests.
